experiments: Two bridge cases staged in the run sandbox (V1a real-workspace chain, V3 Bun lockfile docs), plus two sandbox supplements per the record's plan (V1b installed-tree chain, V2 tsc-vs-grep controls — outputs preserved at scripts/verifications/exp011/).

cases.name: V1a three-layer chain on the real workspace (manifest -> lockfile -> installed/absent)
cases.objective: verify the record's core method on the user's actual project files: manifest ranges, lockfile exact pins, layer drift, fabricated-dependency negative control, and honest layer-3 observation

expected.expectedResult: V1A-CHAIN-VERIFIED with the drift printed and the fabricated package caught
expected.successCriteria: exit 0, manifest range found, exact lockfile pin found, drift shown, fabricated in neither layer, layer 3 verified or absence recorded
expected.failureCriteria: chain broken or fabricated package slips through

cases.name: V3 doc-based: Bun lockfile semantics (live fetch)
cases.objective: verify against the ACTUAL official Bun documentation: the lockfile is created by bun install, is text-based, is distinct from node_modules (--lockfile-only), and should be committed to git

expected.successCriteria: exit 0, all four documented statements found
expected.failureCriteria: doc fetch fails or documented statements differ
